### `r date_bio`

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)

#*******************************************************************************
# get filenames

file_biov1_LHTBI <- paste0(path,"BIO_v1_Carla/",date_bio,"_LHTBI.csv")
file_biov1_pi <- paste0(path,"BIO_v1_Carla/",date_bio,"_pi-20141113.csv")
file_biov1_pp <- paste0(path,"BIO_v1_Carla/",date_bio,"_pp.csv")

file_svgpm <- paste0(path,"VGPM/vgpm.viirs.",date_op,".hdf")
# file_evgpm <- paste0(path,"VGPM/eppley.viirs.",date_op,".hdf")
# file_cbpm <- paste0(path,"VGPM/cbpm.viirs.",date_op,".hdf")

file_biov2_VPI_NU <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"variablePI_NU_BIO_NWA_monthly_",date_bio,".rda")
file_biov2_VPI_U <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"variablePI_U_BIO_NWA_monthly_",date_bio,".rda")
file_biov2_MPI_NU <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"medianPI_NU_BIO_NWA_monthly_",date_bio,".rda")
file_biov2_MPI_U <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"medianPI_U_BIO_NWA_monthly_",date_bio,".rda")


#*******************************************************************************
# read input data

# get input and pp for bio_v1_carla
df_biov1 <- dplyr::bind_cols(fread(file_biov1_LHTBI),fread(file_biov1_pi),fread(file_biov1_pp)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cppday >= 0) %>%
  dplyr::rename(bin=Name)
rast_alphab <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::select(bin,alphaB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_pmb <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::select(bin,PmB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_chl <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::mutate(chl=log10(chlor_a)) %>% dplyr::select(bin,chl), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_lat <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::select(bin,Latitude), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_bathy <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::select(bin,height) %>% dplyr::mutate(height=-height), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_biov1 <- var_to_rast(df_biov1 %>% dplyr::select(bin,cppday), ext=c(xlims,ylims))

# get ocean productivity pp
rast_svgpm <- get_op_pp(file_svgpm,rast_biov1)
# rast_evgpm <- get_op_pp(file_evgpm,rast_biov1)
# rast_cbpm <- get_op_pp(file_cbpm,rast_biov1)

# get biov2 pp
load(file_biov2_VPI_NU)
rast_biov2_VPI_NU = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
load(file_biov2_VPI_U)
rast_biov2_VPI_U = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
load(file_biov2_MPI_NU)
rast_biov2_MPI_NU = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
load(file_biov2_MPI_U)
rast_biov2_MPI_U = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))

```


#### Input variables for BIOv1

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
r1 <- make_raster_map(rast_alphab, title="alphaB_BIOv1")
r2 <- make_raster_map(rast_pmb, title="PmB_BIOv1")
r3 <- make_raster_map(rast_chl, title="log10(chl)_BIOv1")
wrap_plots(list(r1,r2,r3),nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)
```

<br>

#### Original models

```{r, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=10}
pp_rasts <- stack(set_lims(rast_biov1, col_limits_pp),
                  set_lims(rast_svgpm, col_limits_pp))#,
                  # set_lims(rast_evgpm, col_limits_pp),
                  # set_lims(rast_cbpm, col_limits_pp))
names(pp_rasts) <- c("DailyPP_BIOv1",
                     "DailyPP_Standard_VGPM")#,
                     # "DailyPP_Eppley_VGPM",
                     # "DailyPP_CbPM")
m1 <- make_raster_map(pp_rasts, col_limits=col_limits_pp) + theme(plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"))
```

<br>

#### New models

```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=10}
pp_rasts <- stack(set_lims(rast_biov2_VPI_NU, col_limits_pp),
                  set_lims(rast_biov2_VPI_U, col_limits_pp),
                  set_lims(rast_biov2_MPI_NU, col_limits_pp),
                  set_lims(rast_biov2_MPI_U, col_limits_pp))
names(pp_rasts) <- c("DailyPP_BIOv2_VPI_NU",
                     "DailyPP_BIOv2_VPI_U",
                     "DailyPP_BIOv2_MPI_NU",
                     "DailyPP_BIOv2_MPI_U")
make_raster_map(pp_rasts, col_limits=col_limits_pp)
```

<br>

##### Percent difference between new models and BIOv1

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
pdiff_maps(rast_biov1,xlims,rast_biov2_VPI_NU,rast_biov2_VPI_U,rast_biov2_MPI_NU,rast_biov2_MPI_U,col_limits_pdiff,rast_chl,rast_lat,rast_bathy)
```

<br>

##### Percent difference between new models and Standard VGPM

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
pdiff_maps(rast_svgpm,xlims,rast_biov2_VPI_NU,rast_biov2_VPI_U,rast_biov2_MPI_NU,rast_biov2_MPI_U,col_limits_pdiff,rast_chl,rast_lat,rast_bathy)
```
